themes.beneath: Two numbers put Vertex's fall in proportion. It has lost about $10.5 bn of market value (7.3% of $144.0 bn; n:VRTX). JPMorgan estimates peak sales of $3.4 bn a year for this drug in this disease (s1; one bank's estimate). My inference: a fall of about three times one estimate of the drug's best year is more than three months of delay can cost, so the price holds some chance of a later or narrower approval, as the last notes read it. For Vera there are now two things in the price, and neither is sales: a rival's delay (reported) and takeover hope (opinion). Zacks lists Vera among five biotechs named as possible targets after Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $175 a share in cash, about $41 bn, and says all five rose on Nov 24; that is the day Vera rose 7.6%, before any Vertex news (s5, h:VERA). The same page says nothing shows talks are under way.
